stage_1.root_cause: Maintenance ticket maint_2048 remapped logical q2 from physical 2 to 4 (mapping M2), but control binding bind_73 for ent_73 was not regenerated: it still loads K19 bundle cb_73c (profile cp_017, channel u12) calibrated for node_b-node_c, not the node_b-node_e pair now used. Result: cx_1_2 is not correctly realised and the third qubit does not follow the GHZ state, while compile, mapping and schedule layers are all consistent.
stage_1.proposed_repair: Regenerate/rebind bind_73 for ent_73 to the current K20 profile cp_026 on the node_b-node_e pair, refresh the control manifest and execution-time bundle load, add a pre-flight check that every binding's calibration_epoch equals the execution epoch and its profile endpoint_refs equal the scheduled physical qubits, and re-run job with identical circuit/mapping/schedule. Runtime assertion (pre-flight, ProQ-style): before submit, assert for every scheduled CX that binding.calibration_epoch == execution epoch, binding.created_at >= calibration valid_from, and profile.endpoint_refs == endpoint_registry[scheduled physical qubits]; abort the job otherwise.
stage_1.repair_validation: After rebinding: (1) re-run the 8192-shot job and require TVD to ideal GHZ <= ~0.08 (history on a healthy stack: 0.066), P('000')+P('111') >= ~0.89, and pairwise agreement c1c2 and c0c2 >= 0.90 (currently 0.51/0.51); (2) run a short 2-qubit CX probe on physical 1-4 (e.g. X on control, CX, measure) within diagnostic_budget.json and require the target to flip with probability >= ~0.9; (3) control experiment: the same probe on 0-1 must be unchanged; (4) verify the control manifest and execution log now show epoch K20 and the correct profile for every CX.

stage_2.root_cause: Provenance break at the device-model boundary: model-20 was built from geometry revision D20 (fingerprint 7fc9616fd892..., 2026-07-01T09:00:00Z) with coupling proxy 16.0 MHz and was never regenerated for revision D21 (coupler gap 18 um, proxy 18.0 MHz). control calibration cal-21 consumed model-20, so the 15.625 ns rectangular pulse for op_00694 implements theta=1.7672 rad instead of pi/2. Compile, mapping, schedule, runtime and design layers are consistent.
stage_2.proposed_repair: Regenerate the device model from design-21 / fingerprint 74a51d718cc3... (g=18.0 MHz), rebuild cal-21 from the new model (omega=2*pi*18.0/1000=0.11310 rad/ns; pulse 13.889 ns for pi/2, or amplitude scaled by 0.889 at 15.625 ns), update model_ref and control-21, and add a registry check that model.source_geometry_fingerprint equals the current design fingerprint before calibration.
stage_2.repair_validation: (1) Registry check: model, design, backend and runtime fingerprints equal (74a51d718cc3...). (2) Re-run the |++> XI characterization (n=1..8): expect cos(n*pi/2) = 0,-1,0,1,... within 0.004. (3) Re-run verification circuit: <X1> must equal 0.0000 (~0) within 0.004 instead of -0.1932. (4) Re-run main workload with MPS (bond 128/256/512, threshold 1e-10) and check observable deltas converge; (5) confirm other edges (e.g. 0-1) unchanged as a control. Pre-flight assertion (ProQ-style) for every calibration: model.source_geometry_fingerprint == design.geometry_fingerprint == runtime.geometry_fingerprint; abort the job on mismatch.
